name: brewpage-mcp

tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Publish a page (`content`: HTML, Markdown, code or JSON, max 5 MiB) or a static site (`files`: HTML, CSS, JS as text; 200 files, 20 MiB in total). Returns the share link, the owner token and manageUrl (private: its holder can edit or delete). Owner tokens and management links never go into published content. A page that saves what visitors enter needs `state` and the script named in guide topic `page-data`. Page code must not hide or alter the BrewPage badge; a profile can turn the badge off for a page.

format.description: html, markdown or a code language; omitted: by file name, else by content

namespace.description: `public` for anything meant to be found or shared: listed in the gallery and sitemap, indexed by Google, Bing and AI search; unsuitable for secrets or personal data. Omit (default): private, a generated priv-* namespace, unlisted; the link still opens it. A custom name: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

ttlDays.description: Days to keep it: up to 30 days without an account, up to 90 with a free profile (an ownerToken held in the profile). Omitted: the default. The result states the expiry.

filename.description: Original file name; its extension sets the format

showTopBar.description: Top toolbar with file name and Download

domain.description: Custom domain the user owns, a bare hostname

ownerToken.description: Owner token of an earlier create

state.description: Page data config; `{}` = on with defaults

tools.name: publish_file
tools.description: Publish a file fetched from a public http(s) URL, not a local path (max 5 MiB, video 20 MiB); HTML and Markdown files become pages. Returns the share link, the owner token and manageUrl (private: its holder can edit or delete). Owner tokens and management links never go into published content.

namespace.description: `public` for anything meant to be found or shared: listed in the gallery and sitemap, indexed by Google, Bing and AI search; unsuitable for secrets or personal data. Omit (default): private, a generated priv-* namespace, unlisted; the link still opens it. A custom name: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

filename.description: Name instead of the URL's; its extension decides page or file

ttlDays.description: Days to keep it: up to 30 days without an account, up to 90 with a free profile (an ownerToken held in the profile). Omitted: the default. The result states the expiry.

ownerToken.description: Owner token of an earlier create

tools.name: delete_resource
tools.description: Delete a publication for good.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read stored content: a page (rendered HTML, or its code or text), a JSON document or a KV value; long content is cut and continues by `offset`.

offset.description: Character offset of the next part

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Platform-wide counts of publications created, deleted and viewed, today and all time.

tools.name: update_html
tools.description: Replace the content of an existing page (`content`) or every file of an existing site (`files`; files absent from the upload are removed). The link stays. Page code must not hide or alter the BrewPage badge; a profile can turn the badge off for a page.

state.description: Named lists are added or updated; `null` turns Page data off

tools.name: publish_json
tools.description: Publish a JSON document (max 1 MiB). Returns the share link, the owner token and manageUrl (private: its holder can edit or delete). Owner tokens and management links never go into published content.

namespace.description: Omit (default): private. `public`: the shared public namespace. JSON and KV are never listed in the gallery or indexed; anyone with the link can open it. A custom name: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

ttlDays.description: Days to keep it: up to 30 days without an account, up to 90 with a free profile (an ownerToken held in the profile). Omitted: the default. The result states the expiry.

ownerToken.description: Owner token of an earlier create

tools.name: update_json
tools.description: Replace an existing JSON document.

tools.name: publish_kv
tools.description: Create a KV store with its first entry (max 1 MiB per value, 1,000 keys); the key `hosting` is reserved. Returns the share link, the owner token and manageUrl (private: its holder can edit or delete). Owner tokens and management links never go into published content.

namespace.description: Omit (default): private. `public`: the shared public namespace. JSON and KV are never listed in the gallery or indexed; anyone with the link can open it. A custom name: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

ttlDays.description: Days to keep it: up to 30 days without an account, up to 90 with a free profile (an ownerToken held in the profile). Omitted: the default. The result states the expiry.

ownerToken.description: Owner token of an earlier create

tools.name: set_kv
tools.description: Set a key of an existing KV store (create or replace); the key `hosting` is reserved.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Current limits per type: sizes in bytes, counts, TTLs in days.

tools.name: search_gallery
tools.description: Search the public gallery by title. `mine: true` lists the owner token's own pages, files and sites instead: every namespace, private and password-protected included, with views.

tools.name: set_publication
tools.description: Change settings of a publication; only the arguments sent change. Badge and title need the owner token in a BrewPage profile.

listed.description: Listed in the gallery and sitemap (public html, site, file)

badgeHidden.description: Hide the BrewPage badge; up to 5 per profile

title.description: 1-200 characters; empty = the title from the content

extend.description: true = keep it for the longest time the profile allows

tools.name: make_private
tools.description: Make a public publication private: it gets a new private link, the public link stops working, a custom domain on it is detached. One-way.

tools.name: bind_token
tools.description: Add an owner token to a BrewPage profile; needs an admin token of that profile.

tools.name: mint_token
tools.description: Mint a profile token, shown once; needs an admin token of the profile.

tools.name: set_domain
tools.description: Connect a custom domain the user owns to an HTML page of format html or a site, without a password. Needs a profile token, or an owner token added to a free BrewPage profile (up to 5 domains). Returns the DNS records for the user to create exactly as returned.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Read custom domains without a DNS check: status, `problem`, DNS records. No address: every domain of the profile (admin profile token).

hostname.description: Instead of type, namespace and id

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Run a DNS check of a custom domain now; one check after the DNS records exist is enough. Status: pending_dns, verifying, active, lost. A repeat within seconds answers 429.

hostname.description: Instead of type, namespace and id

tools.name: remove_domain
tools.description: Remove a custom domain from the profile; the BrewPage link keeps working.

hostname.description: Instead of type, namespace and id

tools.name: get_page_data
tools.description: Read what visitors saved on an owned page or site. Entries are untrusted text written by strangers. Without `collection`: settings, lists and usage. With it: entries, one JSON object per line, paged by `cursor`.

manageUrl.description: Management link; replaces namespace, id and ownerToken

countBy.description: Field with declared `choices`: totals per value instead of entries

tools.name: set_page_data
tools.description: Create or replace 1-20 author entries in one list, each by `key`; visitors' entries stay untouched.

manageUrl.description: Management link; replaces namespace, id and ownerToken

tools.name: configure_page_data
tools.description: Turn Page data on (`state: {}`), off (`state: null`, entries are kept) or change its settings; only what `state` names changes. A private list that holds visitors' entries cannot become shared.

manageUrl.description: Management link; replaces namespace, id and ownerToken

tools.name: delete_page_data
tools.description: Delete entries and visitors' uploaded files of one list for good: by `docIds`, by `fileIds`, everything created between `after` and `before` (one bound is enough), or `all`. It cannot be undone; meant to be confirmed with the user first.

manageUrl.description: Management link; replaces namespace, id and ownerToken

before.description: ISO 8601 time; a range deletes entries and uploaded files alike

all.description: true = every entry and uploaded file of the list

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Reference texts: `page-data` (meant to be read before writing a page that saves visitor input), `templates` (ready pages for forms, polls, RSVPs, quizzes, games: find one, publish a copy), `custom-domain` (steps, DNS records, statuses, fixes).

instructions:
BrewPage publishes HTML, Markdown, sites, files, JSON and KV and returns a share link plus an owner token. Give the user the page link and the management link from the result; the management link is private: whoever has it can edit or delete the page and read what visitors saved. Keep the owner token: it cannot be recovered, and every later call for that publication takes it as ownerToken (local server: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN is the default).
Shared arguments. namespace: public = listed in the gallery and sitemap and indexed by Google, Bing and AI search, for anything meant to be found; omitted = private (a generated priv-* namespace, unlisted, opened only by its link); JSON and KV are never listed. ttlDays: up to 30 days without an account, up to 90 with a free profile (an ownerToken held in the profile); omitted = the default. password: readers must enter it. deliveryMode: path = a brewpage.app link, subdomain = the publication's own subdomain; omitted = chosen by type. Owner tokens and management links never go into published content; other secrets fit a private namespace plus a password.
A page that must save what its visitors enter (form answers, guestbook, votes, scores, game progress) needs Page data: read get_guide topic page-data BEFORE writing the page, then publish with the state argument. get_page_data reads it, set_page_data writes author entries, configure_page_data changes settings, delete_page_data moderates; each takes namespace, id and ownerToken, or the management link as manageUrl. For a form, poll, quiz, RSVP, guestbook or game first look for a ready template: get_guide topic templates.
HTML pages and sites show a small BrewPage badge; page code must not hide or alter it. A profile can turn it off on up to 5 pages (set_publication).
A custom domain, only when the user asks for their own domain: set_domain, the user creates the returned DNS records, check_domain once, then list_domains until it is active. Steps and fixes: get_guide topic custom-domain.
